subject: 2nd Grade Field Trip to Discovery Science Museum - Permission Slip and Payment Due Friday
text_body:
Dear 2nd Grade Families,

I'm excited to announce our upcoming field trip to the Discovery Science Museum in San Jose! This hands-on learning experience will complement our current science unit on matter and energy.

Trip Details:
- Date: Wednesday, May 20, 2026
- Location: Discovery Science Museum, 201 W Market St, San Jose, CA 95110
- Departure: 9:00 AM from Lincoln Elementary
- Return: 2:30 PM to Lincoln Elementary
- Cost: $15.00 per student (covers admission and bus transportation)

What You Need to Do:
1. Sign and return the attached permission slip by THIS FRIDAY, May 5th
2. Send $15.00 cash or check (payable to Lincoln Elementary) in an envelope with your child's name
3. Indicate on the permission slip if your child will need a school sack lunch

We need 4 parent chaperones! If you're interested, please check the box on the permission slip. Chaperones attend free of charge.

Students should wear comfortable walking shoes and their Lincoln Elementary spirit shirt if they have one.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Warmly,
Mrs. Patricia Chen
2nd Grade Teacher
Lincoln Elementary School
